settings.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
settings.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
settings.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
settings.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
settings.comparison: new_joint minus original_joint; original departure-only comparator unchanged
settings.transfer: fixed0.5 additional increment on exactv78; separately frozen coefficient-one v79 transport
settings.common_error: one shared15-second outer product over the bounded message, exact original3D marginal
settings.scope: existing ambiguous Rome gap gate, original monthly quality gate, supported sources
settings.additional: all supported same-local-day other runway taxi cells intersecting the assigned-day delay cohort; full taxi membership
settings.conditioning: Gaussian Schur moments with one capped variance-matched t5 score weight; unchanged original 3D t5 target likelihood
settings.robust_weight: min(1,(5+k)/(3+q)); q=r_B.T C_BB^-1 r_B, k=extra dimension
settings.review_history: unexecuted 5+q denominator corrected to variance-matched 3+q before any robust prediction; no weight scan
settings.caveat: hybrid approximation; unknown cross-runway source-error covariance and possible prior-error suppression
settings.disconnected: exact recovery when the entire C_AB is zero; adding disconnected coordinates beside informative ones may change global q/k/weight

design.calibration: reuse frozen full2025 parameters and old2026 v78 inference packet; no calibration refit
design.original_clock: original ranking namespace, once-assigned v70 dates; no final-ranking jitter mixing
design.posterior_reference: saved original old_joint; recomputed control atol1e-8 seconds rtol0, log max
design.v78: unchanged matched/recovered bounds and rounding applied to exactv78+0.5*(new_joint-saved_old_joint)
design.retained: same public/quality/calendar memberships, all supports and noise; same source and helper bytes as CV
design.combination: none; any TabM combination is a separate fixed additive-delta design
